fusions.name: End of the Chase
fusions.desc: A finishing blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. You move 30% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Quarry Marker
fusions.desc: Throws a light dart at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Up, Head Down
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds. You move 25% faster for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Smells Weakness
fusions.desc: Against a badly wounded enemy, your damage rises by 12%. You also gain +5% dodge chance.
